headline: Congress authorizes a posthumous Congressional Gold Medal honoring Emmett Till and Mamie Till-Mobley, to be given afterward to the National Museum of African American History and Culture.
what_it_does: The law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded posthumously to Emmett Till and his mother, Mamie Till-Mobley. Once the medal is awarded, it is to be given to the National Museum of African American History and Culture. The official summary does not describe any other requirements or funding details.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 5, 2023. The summary does not give a date for the medal presentation.
